answer: I made two changes. First, I replaced QB25 with QB2. Garnet has only QB1 to QB20, so QB25 does not exist. QB2 is directly coupled to QB1. Second, I replaced cx with native cz. Garnet's native two-qubit gate is cz, and the only allowed locus is [QB2, QB1]. To keep the Bell pair I rebuilt CNOT from native gates. QB2 gets prx(pi/2, pi/2) to make the superposition. QB1 gets prx(-pi/2, pi/2), then cz on [QB2, QB1], then prx(pi/2, pi/2). Both qubits are measured in one measure instruction with key "m". The job ran on garnet:mock with 100 shots and returned {"00": 46, "11": 54}, a Bell pair with no 01 or 10 counts. Credits used: 0 (mock).
